storyline.real: Senna wins his first Grand Prix in heavy rain, more than a minute clear of Alboreto

mastery.label: Win by more than Senna's real 63 seconds

hidden.label: Win without a lap at PUSH in the rain

eras.briefing: Estoril, April 1985. Rain from the start, and it gets heavier. Senna started on pole in the Lotus and leads. The race will be cut short at the two-hour limit. Turbo cars have 220 litres for the race. Pit boards only, no radio. Reconstructed race: no lap timing survives, so the laps are rebuilt from the results and race reports.
